dialogue.text: For thousands of years, bees have been symbols of mindless industry.
dialogue.zh: 數千年來，蜜蜂一直被視為無腦勤勞的象徵。
dialogue.ja: 何千年もの間、ミツバチは無意識の勤勉さの象徴とされてきました。
dialogue.local: For thousands of years, bees have been symbols of mindless industry.
dialogue.en: For thousands of years, bees have been symbols of mindless industry.

dialogue.text: We always think of them as being something like biological robots,
dialogue.zh: 我們總是認為牠們就像生物機器人一樣，
dialogue.ja: 私たちはいつも、ミツバチを生物的なロボットのように考えています。
dialogue.local: We always think of them as being something like biological robots,
dialogue.en: We always think of them as being something like biological robots,

dialogue.text: doomed to live out their lives in lockstep,
dialogue.zh: 注定要步調一致地度過一生，
dialogue.ja: 彼らは一糸乱れぬ生活を送る運命にあると考えられていました。
dialogue.local: doomed to live out their lives in lockstep,
dialogue.en: doomed to live out their lives in lockstep,

dialogue.text: shackled to the dreary roles assigned to them by nature.
dialogue.zh: 被自然賦予的枯燥角色所束縛。
dialogue.ja: 自然によって割り当てられた退屈な役割に縛られているのです。
dialogue.local: shackled to the dreary roles assigned to them by nature.
dialogue.en: shackled to the dreary roles assigned to them by nature.

dialogue.text: This is our first contact story.
dialogue.zh: 這是我們的首次接觸故事。
dialogue.ja: これは私たちの最初の接触の物語です。
dialogue.local: This is our first contact story.
dialogue.en: This is our first contact story.

dialogue.text: It happened at a place called Rulinko,
dialogue.zh: 事情發生在一個叫做魯林科的地方，
dialogue.ja: それはルリンコという場所で起こりました。
dialogue.local: It happened at a place called Rulinko,
dialogue.en: It happened at a place called Rulinko,

dialogue.text: in rural Austria in the early 1900s.
dialogue.zh: 位於20世紀初的奧地利鄉村。
dialogue.ja: 1900年代初頭のオーストリアの田舎です。
dialogue.local: in rural Austria in the early 1900s.
dialogue.en: in rural Austria in the early 1900s.

dialogue.text: From the time Carl von Frisch was a child,
dialogue.zh: 從卡爾·馮·弗里施還是小孩時起，
dialogue.ja: カール・フォン・フリッシュが子供の頃から、
dialogue.local: From the time Carl von Frisch was a child,
dialogue.en: From the time Carl von Frisch was a child,

dialogue.text: he long to understand what the other animals knew,
dialogue.zh: 他渴望了解其他動物所知道的事，
dialogue.ja: 彼は他の動物たちが何を知っているのか理解したがっていました。
dialogue.local: he long to understand what the other animals knew,
dialogue.en: he long to understand what the other animals knew,

dialogue.text: how they perceived the world.
dialogue.zh: 牠們如何感知這個世界。
dialogue.ja: 彼らが世界をどのように認識しているのかを。
dialogue.local: how they perceived the world.
dialogue.en: how they perceived the world.

dialogue.text: He wanted to know if tiny fish saw color or had a sense of smell.
dialogue.zh: 他想知道小魚是否能看見顏色或有嗅覺。
dialogue.ja: 彼は小さな魚が色を見たり、嗅覚を持っているか知りたがっていました。
dialogue.local: He wanted to know if tiny fish saw color or had a sense of smell.
dialogue.en: He wanted to know if tiny fish saw color or had a sense of smell.

dialogue.text: He invented experiments to explore animal experience, and he filmed them.
dialogue.zh: 他發明了實驗來探索動物的感知，並將其拍攝下來。
dialogue.ja: 彼は動物の感覚を探る実験を考案し、それを撮影しました。
dialogue.local: He invented experiments to explore animal experience, and he filmed them.
dialogue.en: He invented experiments to explore animal experience, and he filmed them.

dialogue.text: Starting in the early 20th century, he was the first to use the new medium of motion pictures to create popular science entertainment and communication.
dialogue.zh: 20世紀初，他是第一個利用電影這種新媒介來創造科普娛樂與傳播的人。
dialogue.ja: 20世紀初頭から、彼は映画という新しい媒体を使って、科学の娯楽と情報発信を初めて行いました。
dialogue.local: Starting in the early 20th century, he was the first to use the new medium of motion pictures to create popular science entertainment and communication.
dialogue.en: Starting in the early 20th century, he was the first to use the new medium of motion pictures to create popular science entertainment and communication.

dialogue.text: For thousands of years, humans have noted the eccentric dances of the bees.
dialogue.zh: 數千年來，人類注意到蜜蜂古怪的舞蹈。
dialogue.ja: 何千年もの間、人間はミツバチの奇妙な踊りに気づいていました。
dialogue.local: For thousands of years, humans have noted the eccentric dances of the bees.
dialogue.en: For thousands of years, humans have noted the eccentric dances of the bees.

dialogue.text: But no one had ever looked at them with the kind of respect that assumed there was a reason to their dancing.
dialogue.zh: 但沒有人以尊重的態度看待牠們，認為牠們跳舞是有原因的。
dialogue.ja: しかし、誰もその踊りに理由があると尊重して見たことはありませんでした。
dialogue.local: But no one had ever looked at them with the kind of respect that assumed there was a reason to their dancing.
dialogue.en: But no one had ever looked at them with the kind of respect that assumed there was a reason to their dancing.

dialogue.text: Before Carl von Frisch, no one ever thought to ask why they moved this way in that way in a succession of elaborate figure-eight.
dialogue.zh: 在卡爾·馮·弗里施之前，沒有人想過為什麼牠們會以這種方式連續做出複雜的八字形舞動。
dialogue.ja: カール・フォン・フリッシュ以前は、なぜミツバチが複雑な8の字を連続して動くのか誰も考えませんでした。
dialogue.local: Before Carl von Frisch, no one ever thought to ask why they moved this way in that way in a succession of elaborate figure-eight.
dialogue.en: Before Carl von Frisch, no one ever thought to ask why they moved this way in that way in a succession of elaborate figure-eight.

dialogue.text: von Frisch studied every tiny bee gesture and became fascinated by a mystery he couldn't explain.
dialogue.zh: 馮·弗里施研究了每一個微小的蜜蜂動作，並對一個無法解釋的謎團著迷。
dialogue.ja: フォン・フリッシュはミツバチの細かな動きを研究し、説明できない謎に魅了されました。
dialogue.local: von Frisch studied every tiny bee gesture and became fascinated by a mystery he couldn't explain.
dialogue.en: von Frisch studied every tiny bee gesture and became fascinated by a mystery he couldn't explain.

dialogue.text: He would set out a dish of sugar water for a bee from his experimental hive.
dialogue.zh: 他會為實驗蜂巢中的蜜蜂擺放一盤糖水。
dialogue.ja: 彼は実験用の巣箱からミツバチのために砂糖水の皿を用意しました。
dialogue.local: He would set out a dish of sugar water for a bee from his experimental hive.
dialogue.en: He would set out a dish of sugar water for a bee from his experimental hive.

dialogue.text: The bee would feast upon it before flying back home.
dialogue.zh: 蜜蜂會先大快朵頤，然後飛回家。
dialogue.ja: ミツバチはそれを食べてから巣に戻りました。
dialogue.local: The bee would feast upon it before flying back home.
dialogue.en: The bee would feast upon it before flying back home.

dialogue.text: The marked bee would later return to dine of the delicious sugar water.
dialogue.zh: 被標記的蜜蜂稍後會回來享用美味的糖水。
dialogue.ja: 印をつけられたミツバチは後でまたその美味しい砂糖水を飲みに戻ってきました。
dialogue.local: The marked bee would later return to dine of the delicious sugar water.
dialogue.en: The marked bee would later return to dine of the delicious sugar water.

dialogue.text: von Frisch noted that in just a few hours, a multitude of other bees would join her there.
dialogue.zh: 馮·弗里施注意到，短短幾小時內，許多其他蜜蜂會加入她。
dialogue.ja: フォン・フリッシュは、数時間のうちに多くの他のミツバチが彼女のもとに集まることに気づきました。
dialogue.local: von Frisch noted that in just a few hours, a multitude of other bees would join her there.
dialogue.en: von Frisch noted that in just a few hours, a multitude of other bees would join her there.

dialogue.text: They were always her fellow hive mates.
dialogue.zh: 牠們總是她的同巢蜂。
dialogue.ja: それらはいつも彼女の巣仲間でした。
dialogue.local: They were always her fellow hive mates.
dialogue.en: They were always her fellow hive mates.

dialogue.text: But here was the really amazing thing.
dialogue.zh: 但這裡有件真正令人驚奇的事。
dialogue.ja: しかし、ここで本当に驚くべきことがありました。
dialogue.local: But here was the really amazing thing.
dialogue.en: But here was the really amazing thing.

dialogue.text: von Frisch knew that the other bees had not followed the marked bee to the feeding place.
dialogue.zh: 馮·弗里施知道其他蜜蜂並沒有跟隨被標記的蜜蜂到食物處。
dialogue.ja: フォン・フリッシュは、他のミツバチが印をつけられたミツバチを追って餌場に行ったわけではないと知っていました。
dialogue.local: von Frisch knew that the other bees had not followed the marked bee to the feeding place.
dialogue.en: von Frisch knew that the other bees had not followed the marked bee to the feeding place.

dialogue.text: How?
dialogue.zh: 怎麼可能？
dialogue.ja: どうして？
dialogue.local: How?
dialogue.en: How?

dialogue.text: Because he had the hive closely watched at all times.
dialogue.zh: 因為他一直密切監視著蜂巢。
dialogue.ja: なぜなら彼は常に巣箱を厳重に監視していたからです。
dialogue.local: Because he had the hive closely watched at all times.
dialogue.en: Because he had the hive closely watched at all times.

dialogue.text: He had been careful to use sugar water not honey, so that the bees' sense of smell could not guide them to the reward.
dialogue.zh: 他小心使用糖水而非蜂蜜，讓蜜蜂的嗅覺無法引導牠們找到食物。
dialogue.ja: 彼は蜂蜜ではなく砂糖水を使い、ミツバチの嗅覚が報酬を導けないように注意しました。
dialogue.local: He had been careful to use sugar water not honey, so that the bees' sense of smell could not guide them to the reward.
dialogue.en: He had been careful to use sugar water not honey, so that the bees' sense of smell could not guide them to the reward.

dialogue.text: He continued to move the dish of sugar water far away until it was several kilometers from the hive.
dialogue.zh: 他持續將糖水盤移得很遠，直到距離蜂巢數公里。
dialogue.ja: 彼は砂糖水の皿をどんどん遠くに移動させ、巣箱から数キロ離れた場所に置きました。
dialogue.local: He continued to move the dish of sugar water far away until it was several kilometers from the hive.
dialogue.en: He continued to move the dish of sugar water far away until it was several kilometers from the hive.

dialogue.text: Still, the hive mates would find their way to it.
dialogue.zh: 然而，巢內的其他蜜蜂仍能找到那裡。
dialogue.ja: それでも、巣仲間たちはその場所を見つけることができました。
dialogue.local: Still, the hive mates would find their way to it.
dialogue.en: Still, the hive mates would find their way to it.

dialogue.text: So how did the painted bee reveal the exact location of the sugar war with such precision that her hive mates could unerringly find their way there?
dialogue.zh: 那麼，被標記的蜜蜂如何如此精確地傳達糖水的位置，讓同巢蜜蜂能準確找到呢？
dialogue.ja: では、印をつけられたミツバチはどのようにして、巣仲間が迷わずにその場所を見つけられるほど正確に砂糖水の位置を伝えたのでしょうか？
dialogue.local: So how did the painted bee reveal the exact location of the sugar war with such precision that her hive mates could unerringly find their way there?
dialogue.en: So how did the painted bee reveal the exact location of the sugar war with such precision that her hive mates could unerringly find their way there?

dialogue.text: There was a secret message in her choreography.
dialogue.zh: 她的舞蹈中藏有秘密訊息。
dialogue.ja: 彼女の振り付けには秘密のメッセージがありました。
dialogue.local: There was a secret message in her choreography.
dialogue.en: There was a secret message in her choreography.

dialogue.text: What had seemed to countless generations of observers to be nothing more than the meaningless spasmodic motions of a dumb animal was actually a complex message,
dialogue.zh: 對無數世代的觀察者來說，這看似無意義的痙攣動作，其實是一個複雜的訊息，
dialogue.ja: 何世代にもわたる観察者には、ただの意味のない痙攣のように見えた動きが、実は複雑なメッセージだったのです。
dialogue.local: What had seemed to countless generations of observers to be nothing more than the meaningless spasmodic motions of a dumb animal was actually a complex message,
dialogue.en: What had seemed to countless generations of observers to be nothing more than the meaningless spasmodic motions of a dumb animal was actually a complex message,

dialogue.text: an equation informed by mathematics, astronomy, and an acute knowledge of time.
dialogue.zh: 這是一個結合數學、天文學及精確時間知識的方程式。
dialogue.ja: それは数学、天文学、そして鋭い時間の知識に基づく方程式でした。
dialogue.local: an equation informed by mathematics, astronomy, and an acute knowledge of time.
dialogue.en: an equation informed by mathematics, astronomy, and an acute knowledge of time.

dialogue.text: All synthesized to convey the location of the riches she hoped to share with her sisters.
dialogue.zh: 這些元素綜合起來，傳達她希望與姐妹們分享的寶藏位置。
dialogue.ja: すべてが統合されて、彼女が姉妹たちと共有したい豊かな場所の位置を伝えていました。
dialogue.local: All synthesized to convey the location of the riches she hoped to share with her sisters.
dialogue.en: All synthesized to convey the location of the riches she hoped to share with her sisters.

dialogue.text: The dancer used the angle of our star, the sun, to indicate the general direction of the food's location.
dialogue.zh: 舞者利用我們的恆星——太陽的角度，來指示食物的大致方向。
dialogue.ja: 踊り手は私たちの星、太陽の角度を使って食べ物の大まかな方向を示しました。
dialogue.local: The dancer used the angle of our star, the sun, to indicate the general direction of the food's location.
dialogue.en: The dancer used the angle of our star, the sun, to indicate the general direction of the food's location.

dialogue.text: Von Frisch noted that when a bee danced straight upward, she meant fly toward the sun.
dialogue.zh: 馮·弗里施指出，當蜜蜂直線向上舞動時，代表朝向太陽飛行。
dialogue.ja: フォン・フリッシュは、ミツバチが真っすぐ上に踊るときは太陽の方向に飛べという意味だと指摘しました。
dialogue.local: Von Frisch noted that when a bee danced straight upward, she meant fly toward the sun.
dialogue.en: Von Frisch noted that when a bee danced straight upward, she meant fly toward the sun.

dialogue.text: And when she moved downward, she meant fly away from it.
dialogue.zh: 當牠向下舞動時，代表遠離太陽飛行。
dialogue.ja: そして下に動くときは、太陽から離れて飛べという意味です。
dialogue.local: And when she moved downward, she meant fly away from it.
dialogue.en: And when she moved downward, she meant fly away from it.

dialogue.text: Her swivels left and right conveyed the food's exact coordinates in space, sometimes kilometers away.
dialogue.zh: 牠左右旋轉的動作傳達了食物在空間中的精確座標，有時距離數公里。
dialogue.ja: 彼女の左右の回転は、時には数キロ離れた食べ物の正確な座標を伝えました。
dialogue.local: Her swivels left and right conveyed the food's exact coordinates in space, sometimes kilometers away.
dialogue.en: Her swivels left and right conveyed the food's exact coordinates in space, sometimes kilometers away.

dialogue.text: The duration of her dance, down to a fraction of a second, indicated the length of time it would take her fellow bees to get there.
dialogue.zh: 舞蹈的持續時間，精確到秒的分數，表示同伴蜜蜂到達那裡所需的時間。
dialogue.ja: 彼女の踊りの時間は、秒の一部まで正確に示されており、仲間のミツバチがそこに到達するのにかかる時間を表していました。
dialogue.local: The duration of her dance, down to a fraction of a second, indicated the length of time it would take her fellow bees to get there.
dialogue.en: The duration of her dance, down to a fraction of a second, indicated the length of time it would take her fellow bees to get there.

dialogue.text: She even factored in wind speed to more finely calibrate the message she danced.
dialogue.zh: 她甚至考慮了風速，以更精確地調整她舞蹈所傳達的訊息。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は風速も考慮に入れて、踊りのメッセージをより正確に調整していました。
dialogue.local: She even factored in wind speed to more finely calibrate the message she danced.
dialogue.en: She even factored in wind speed to more finely calibrate the message she danced.

dialogue.text: And this was true at any time of the year and from hive to hive, from continent to continent.
dialogue.zh: 這在一年中的任何時候，從一個蜂巢到另一個蜂巢，從一個大陸到另一個大陸都是如此。
dialogue.ja: これは一年中いつでも、巣箱から巣箱へ、大陸から大陸へと共通していました。
dialogue.local: And this was true at any time of the year and from hive to hive, from continent to continent.
dialogue.en: And this was true at any time of the year and from hive to hive, from continent to continent.

dialogue.text: Bees can do the math.
dialogue.zh: 蜜蜂會算數。
dialogue.ja: ミツバチは計算ができるのです。
dialogue.local: Bees can do the math.
dialogue.en: Bees can do the math.
